questions.prompt: Which of these actors have played James Bond?
questions.fact: Seven actors have played him on film. Sean Connery was the first and almost turned it down.

questions.prompt: How many lines are there in a sonnet?
questions.fact: Fourteen, always. The last two usually turn the argument of the first twelve on its head.

questions.prompt: How long can a giant tortoise live, in years?
questions.fact: Well past 150. One taken from the Galapagos by Charles Darwin's crew was still alive in a zoo in 2006.

questions.prompt: Which spice gives a curry its yellow colour?
questions.hint: It is a root, sold ground to a bright powder, and it stains everything.
questions.fact: Turmeric. The colour comes from curcumin, and it will stain a chopping board for good.

questions.prompt: Which country has a flag that is not a rectangle?
questions.hint: Its flag is two stacked triangles, one carrying a moon and one a sun.
questions.fact: Nepal's flag is two stacked pennants. Every other national flag in the world is four-sided.
